style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: buddhi and dhriti are the inner tools of choice
candidates.evidence: बुद्धेः ... धृतेः च ... त्रिविधं ... गुणतः ... धनञ्जय

en.intro: Krishna now turns to the inner equipment of the mind, the tools of understanding and steadfastness.
en.notice: Krishna turns to buddhi and dhriti, the mind and resolve, and promises to separate each into its three qualities.
en.next: Sattvic buddhi is the clarity that knows what binds and what frees.
en.meaning: O Dhananjaya, now hear the threefold distinctions of understanding and steadfastness according to the three qualities, fully and separately explained.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अब मन के उन साधनों की ओर मुड़ते हैं, समझ और दृढ़ता के साधन।
hi.meaning: हे धनञ्जय, अब तू गुणों के अनुसार बुद्धि और धृति के भी तीन प्रकार के भेद अलग-अलग रूप से सुन, जो कि मेरे द्वारा पूर्ण रूप से कहे जा रहे हैं।
hi.notice: कृष्ण बुद्धी और धृति, यानी मन और संकल्प, की ओर मुड़ते हैं और प्रत्येक को तीन गुणों में अलग-अलग बाँटने का वादा करते हैं।
hi.next: सात्विक बुद्धि वह स्पष्टता है जो जानती है कि क्या बाँधता है और क्या मुक्त करता है।

en.intro: Krishna now turns to the inner equipment of the mind, the tools of understanding and steadfastness.
en.body: O Dhananjaya, now hear the threefold distinctions of understanding and steadfastness according to the three qualities, fully and separately explained. Krishna turns to buddhi and dhriti, the mind and resolve, and promises to separate each into its three qualities. Sattvic buddhi is the clarity that knows what binds and what frees.
